criteria.assessment: The task detail route exposes task outcome, dependencies, related scenarios and tests, with missing mappings stated explicitly.

integration.assessment: The accepted task-detail AppTest exercises the integrated workbench route and its related records.

criteria.assessment: The task list keeps lifecycle, runtime state, and verified completion distinct while retaining related implementation evidence.

integration.assessment: The task-detail and completed-task cases inspect the rendered list and detail state.

criteria.assessment: Completed and incomplete records remain discoverable without fabricating completion for legacy or unrecorded work.

integration.assessment: The completed-task case verifies related tests/results and explicit absence of verified evidence.

tests.assertion_assessment: The candidate-bound test passes and verifies the task route, filters, detail sections, related records, and implementation evidence.
tests.counterexample: Removing the task renderer or route wiring removes the required detail sections and fails the AppTest assertions.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: The genuine red run fails by behavior assertion when the task detail assertion is absent; the exact candidate passes after the implementation and accepted test binding are restored.

tests.assertion_assessment: The candidate-bound test passes and verifies task lifecycle versus verified completion and discoverability of related records.
tests.counterexample: Treating planned or runtime status as completed would make the lifecycle/completion assertion fail.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: The candidate-bound red run has valid collection and a behavior assertion failure; final green passes after the task detail behavior is complete.
